description: Chinese Academy of Sciences institutes digitised 237 Liaoning soil types from the province’s Second National Soil Survey, published as a soil reference in 1991. Seven tables describe classifications, profile horizons, physical and chemical properties, productivity and administrative distribution. The ScienceDB repository publishes the resulting XLS workbook with CC BY 4.0, allowing free reuse. These profile descriptions can support soil parameter selection in agricultural-water and land-response simulations. The publication year is a provenance date, not evidence that every sample was measured in 1991, and the underlying historical survey is limited by subsequent land changes. The data describe soil types, not a current engineering borehole network. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
name: A dataset of Liaoning soil species based on the Second National Soil Survey
